versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides four main capabilities: Douyin keyword search, creator post retrieval, video comment extraction, and real-time trending topics, returning structured JSON data.
- Automatically parses and maps common spoken filters (e.g., "past week," "most liked") to command arguments.
- Designed strictly for data retrieval; does not support content publishing, editing, downloading, or management for other platforms.
- Enforces strict token management and user data privacy, with robust input/output and error handling standards.
- Includes command-line usage examples, parameter mapping rules, and clear limits for responsible data use.
